decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that domain reassignment alone is insufficient and that settings and subscriptions are account-bound.
Account-bound settings and subscriptions do not change the requirement that each location use its own website connected through the master website.
The source explains why domain reassignment alone cannot correct the broader account mix-up, but it does not change the required master-domain mapping.
The account-bound configuration fact does not alter the established expansion capability, reusable template, or future-location strategy.
The source does not change which locations are selectable or how visitors are routed from the master site.
Although subscriptions and settings are account-bound, the source does not modify booking placement, isolation, or Ridgehaven booking activation.
The source does not change the requirement for independently controlled Ridgehaven staff access.
The source does not change the required separation of location analytics, reporting, revenue, or sales tracking.
The source does not modify the separate payout requirement or the established location-specific payment setup.
The account-bound settings and subscriptions explanation does not change the separate-calendar rule or calendar placement.
The source does not change the requirement to keep the legacy site live or preserve its master-site linkage during transition.
The source identifies settings and subscriptions as account-bound but does not change the separate customer-database requirement.
